The '''Membrane defense system''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]-like system produced by the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It combined a low-strength deflector shield with unknown [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]]-designed technologies, which provided a constant boost to a ship's evasion rating, and also allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to temporarily provide an additional massive evasion boost.
